news.intro:
20 new cosmetics, sold one by one,
and faster cosmetics sync.
news.i.fabric.d: New Fabric client for the latest Minecraft with a mod menu on Right Shift and a draggable, resizable HUD.
news.i.crystal.d: Supplies counter (crystals, obsidian, totems, gapples), Target HUD and totem pops, plus FPS, CPS, Keystrokes, armor, potions, ping and more.
news.i.mods189.d: Chat (no background, resizable), No Clouds, Block Outline with custom colors and Smooth Shift.
news.i.fps.d: FPS Boost is on by default with better JVM settings, so you get a lot more frames.
news.i.zoom.d: Zoom with the mouse wheel as much as you want and a gentler motion blur.
news.i.speed.d: The mod menu and the chat open much faster.
news.i.keys.d: WASD and jump no longer get stuck or press on their own.
news.i.anim17.d: Sword swing on the ground and block animation now work like on 1.7.
news.i.launcher.d: Automatic Java 25 for the new versions and a more reliable updater.
news.i.mods.d: Combo, Bow Charge, Block Info, No Hurt Cam, Background FPS, Low Health, Target HUD, Item Counter, Inventory HUD, Nearby Players, Hit Color, AutoGG, Minimap and 1.7 Animations.
news.i.wings.d: Black 3D dragon wings with a smooth, continuous flap animation, plus a fully black cape with the white infinity logo.
news.i.tab.t: Client logo in the tab list
news.i.tab.d: Players using YA CLIENT now show the real logo next to their name.
news.i.news.d: This sheet: every update is listed here with all details.
news.i.menus.d: Main menu, hub and mod menus are more compact and scale properly on any screen.
news.i.cosmetics.d: Tags no longer cover the preview, names and status are clearly separated and wings stay inside the card.
news.i.anim.d: Wings keep flapping while you walk, jump or fall instead of resetting.
news.i.updates.d: The launcher can now update itself from GitHub releases.
news.i.hitboxes.d: Entity hitboxes are re-applied every frame so they stay on.
news.i.oldanim.d: Sword block-hit swing and lower sword position now work.
news.i.wingreset.d: Fixed the wing animation stopping when moving.
news.i.tabletters.d: Removed the placeholder letters in the tab list in favour of the logo.

news.i.singles.d: 5 capes, 5 pairs of wings, 5 bands and 5 pets you can buy one by one, 3.49 each. No need to buy a whole bundle.
news.i.pixel.d: Pixel art capes, wings in many colours with a realistic flap and cute pixel pets.
news.i.phone.d: The store now shows 3 products per row on your phone.
news.i.sync.d: When a player changes cosmetics, the others see it in about 2 seconds instead of 8.
news.i.perf.d: Wings, capes and pets are built once and reused, so crowded servers run smoother.
news.i.photos.d: Store, site and launcher show every cosmetic full body on your own skin, all framed the same way.
news.i.tagfix.d: The YA logo next to a name stays aligned, also in front view and when spectating.
